Co pro vás připravujeme?: What are we preparing for you?
Potřebujeme vědět, co nejvíce o vaší úro: We need to know as much as possible about your level and what you want to learn at our MTB school. At our first meeting we will agree on the form of coaching that suits you best and find out which areas of your riding technique you want to improve. You will need your beloved bike and safety gear (helmet, gloves, sturdy shoes). Ideally come without SPD pedals – we can lend you ours if agreed in advance. Bring your own food and drinks (does not apply to camps).
Pro individuální kurzy i campy máme možn: For individual courses and camps we use the beautiful leisure park in Tehov, which we built together with the municipality – it has a technical trail, a pump track and Trial features. We can also travel to bike parks or trails anywhere in the Czech Republic. We adapt to your schedule, and the total lesson time is planned according to what we will practise. There are also many beautiful natural spots nearby with different surfaces and levels of technical difficulty.
Každý se zlepšuje vlastním tempem a úkol: Everyone improves at their own pace, and the aim of the Bikeskills project is to find your limits, set the right approach and – through advice and demonstration – help you make as much progress as possible. From balance and trails to riding difficult terrain and jumps, we will be your guides to improving or understanding the basics. Photos and video of your achievements can also be arranged on request. We love following our students' progress in their biking life.{1}{2}

Rychlá a efektivní forma jak předat všem: A quick and effective way to pass on what we know to every rider. Some people are shy, others simply want faster progress – and one-to-one coaching delivers exactly that. Of course you can also bring a few friends or your partner.

Máte čas jen během svého HomeOffice dnu,: Do you only have time during your home-office day or after work? Do you need intensive coaching and want the instructor to really get to know your riding? Are you an amateur biker, or a pro who wants to refine their technique or learn a particular trick or specific skill? Then this form of coaching is perfect for you.{1}{2}We will find your limits and the edges of your comfort zone and work together to push past them. Sometimes we are surprised ourselves how quickly our clients and club riders progress under the right guidance. If you like, we will happily coach you for a whole season, or just for one day. Lessons can be held in English.{3}{4}We train on {5}MTBs{6}, {7}e-bikes{8} and Trial bikes. Trial bikes can also be rented from us.
K dispozici máme výukové centrum v Tehov: Our training centre in Tehov near Říčany is easy to reach by car or train, and the surrounding forests hide a true biker's paradise for learning technique. Prague also has some beautiful places to ride. We are also happy to come to you and ride your favourite trail, head to a bike park, or go on a trip abroad.
KOHO MOHU POZVAT A PRO KOHO JE KURZ URČE: WHO CAN I BRING AND WHO IS THE COURSE FOR?
Ve dvou se to lépe táhne a víc hlav víc: Two pull better than one, and two heads are better than one. Old sayings, but they really apply on the bike. We will happily welcome you with your family, a friend, colleagues from work or your MTB / e-bike team. It works best when riders are at a similar technical level. It's not just about pushing each other, but also about practising together afterwards on your own rides.

Víkendové, nebo jednodenní campy či work: Weekend or one-day camps and workshops for everyone who wants to learn basic and advanced technique, ride with a great group of people and enjoy everything the bike has to offer. A workshop can also be an attractive side programme for your event – spectators learn something and can even have a go themselves.
Každý rok plánujeme pouze omezený počet: Every year we plan only a limited number of camps, and we intend to enjoy them to the full. The focus is always the same – technique – but the difficulty level varies. We're not big travellers, so most camps take place in Central Bohemia for smaller groups of riders we can fully dedicate ourselves to. Your time and ours is precious, so our camps last two days at most and the coaching is designed accordingly.
Campů se budou účastnit hlavní instrukto: The camps are led by the main instructors from our{1} TEAM{2}, as well as advanced members of our club MTB & TRIAL Mraveniště Říčany, who have many years of racing experience in various disciplines themselves. We have plenty to say about technique, and speed is no stranger to any of our members either. Enduro, DH, XC, Trial – we've ridden it all, even though each of us has a different main discipline.
Účast na campu je vždy na vlastní nebezp: Participation in a camp is always at your own risk. Every participant must wear a helmet and sturdy shoes; protectors are optional. Each rider is responsible for the technical condition of their own bike. Please inform the instructors in advance about any health issues. The briefing includes a short safety talk. First aid will be within driving distance of the camp, or a medic will be present on site.
Uvítání / snídaně, vyzpovídání účastníků: Welcome / breakfast, a chat with participants, warm-up, a bit of theory with demonstrations, splitting into groups if needed – and then we get to it. After a few hours of training we have lunch together, go through what you've learned and choose the next focus of the coaching and our rides. To finish, you can join us for dinner with a camp review and our final tips for you.
Pokud máte vybraný camp, přihlaste se po: Once you have chosen a camp, sign up using the registration form. Alternatively, email us at {1}info@bikeskills.cz{2}, or call {3}+420 608 959 098{4}. A camp can also be given as a gift voucher.
Náš team instruktorů má za sebou více ne: Our team of instructors has more than 30 years on the bike. We have raced at home and around the world in Elite Trial categories, organised many sports and social events, we are ambassadors of several cycling projects, ride for a number of leading brands on the Czech market and work with TV shows focused on cycling. We will gladly bring all this experience to your event in the form of an educational workshop.{1}{2}We provide complete facilities – from an obstacle course (local terrain can also be used) to a sound system, hosts, tents, Trialshow obstacles and bikes to borrow.{3}{4}We can also put on a small exhibition on mountain bikes / e-bikes, or a full-scale Trial show on trial bikes, which can be combined with a moto-trial show, parkour or unicycling.

Za více než 30 let na kole a objíždění m: After more than 30 years on the bike, travelling to international Trial, XC, Enduro and other races – with our exhibition show or as racers – we've realised that fitness alone won't bring you success. Technique is what takes you to the top in a race. This applies without exception to amateur riders and beginners too, who would rather count kilometres ridden than hours trained off-road. Our mission is to make the time that pros and amateurs devote to technical bike skills more enjoyable.
BÁVÍME SE NA VŠECH TYPECH KOL{1}: WE ENJOY ALL TYPES OF BIKES{1}
Díky testování pro výrobce kol i kompone: Thanks to testing for bike and component manufacturers, TV shows and other Czech and international media, we've come into contact with just about everything that has handlebars and two wheels (sometimes just one :)). We've raced and performed exhibitions on just about anything you can think of. But most importantly, we love constantly improving and we live by the Trial philosophy of “overcoming obstacles”. We'll pass the same on to you in our courses.
